content: Mahwen Ong mehn Amalek

Samuel eri padahkihong Sohl, “Ih ngehi me KAUN-O ketin poaronehdo pwe I en keieikomwihdi pwe komwi en wiahla nanmwarkien sapwellime aramas en Israel. Eri, komw karonge dahme KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalap, ketin mahsanih.
E pahn ketin kaloke mehn Amalek kan pwehki ar pelianda mehn Israel kan ni ar kohkohdo sang Isip.

Eri, kohwei oh mahweniong irail oh kamwomwala douluhl mehkoaros me mie rehrail. Sohte mehkot pahn luhwehdi: ohl akan, lih akan, seri kan, me pwelel kan, kou oh sihpw kan, kamel oh ahs akan, koaros pahn kamakamala.”
Sohl eri kapokonepene sapwellime karis en sounpei kan oh ketin kasawih irail nan Telem: irail me 200,000 sang Israel oh 10,000 sang Suda.
Ih oh sapwellime sounpei ko ahpw kolahng Amalek, oh awihiraildi nan pillap madada pwoat.

E ahpw kehkehlingkihong mehn Ken kan, mahsanih, “Kumwail kohwei oh tohrohreweisang mehn Amalek kan, pwe kumwail en dehr iang irail kamakamala. Pwe kumwail inenen kadek ong mehn Israel kan ni ar kohdo sang Isip.” Mehn Ken ko eri kohkohla sang rehn mehn Amalek ko.
Sohl eri kalowehdi mehn Amalek ko sang Apila lellahng Sur, palimesehn Isip.
E ahpw koledi Akak, nanmwarkien Amalek, ahpw e sohte kamakamala. A aramas teikan koaros kamakamala.

Eri, Sohl oh sapwellime ko sohte kemehla Akak, oh pil sohte kemehla sihpw me keieu mwahu, oh kou, oh koupwul, oh sihmpwul, oh mehkot me keieu kaselel. Ahpw mehkoaros me sohte kesempwal de katepe, re kamwomwala.
Koht ketin Soikala Sohl sang eh Nanmwarki
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Samuel,

“I koluhkilahr ei kasapwilada Sohl nanmwarki; pwe e sohpeisang ie oh solahr kin kapwaiada ei kosonned akan.” Samuel eri nsensuwedkihla kowahlap, oh nipwongo pwon e wie ngidingidkihong KAUN-O eh pekipek.
Mandahn rahno, nimensehngie, e ahpw ketila rapahki Sohl. E ahpw rongada me Sohl samwalahngehr kahnimw Karmel, wasa e kauwada ie mehn kataman ehu ong pein ih; oh mwuhr, e ahpw kohkohla Kilkal.
Samuel eri lella reh. Sohl ahpw rahnmwahwih, mahsanih, “KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwih komwi, Samuel! I kapwaiadahr sapwellimen KAUN-O mahsen kan.”
Samuel eri patohwan idek, “A dahme I rongorongki ngilen kou oh ngilen sihpw?”

Sohl ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “Nei sounpei kat me kihsang rehn mehn Amalek ko. Re katohrehla me keieu mwahu rehn sihpw kan oh kou kan mehn wia meirong ong KAUN-O, omw Koht. A meteiko koaros se kamwomwala douluhl.”
Samuel ahpw patohwanohng, “Erier! Met I pahn kasalehiong komwi dahme KAUN-O ketin mahseniong ie pwohng.” Sohl ahpw sapeng, “Komw mahsanihodo.”
Samuel eri patohwan, “Sohl, mehnda ma komwi wiahkin komwi aramas tikitik, ahpw komwi me kaunen kadaudok kan en Israel. KAUN-O ketin keieikomwihdi nanmwarkien Israel,
oh ketin poaroneikomwihwei, oh mahsanih komwi en kamwomwala aramas suwed ko en Amalek. E mahsanih komwi en mahweniong irail, komw lao kameirailla koaros.
Eri, dahme kahrehda komw sohte peikikihong? Dahme kahrehda komw noarokekihda dipwisou ko, oh wiahkihda mehkot me uhwong kupwur en KAUN-O?”
Sohl ahpw sapeng Samuel, mahsanih, “I peikiongehr KAUN-O. I patohla nin duwen me e mahsanih, oh patohwando Nanmwarki Akak, oh kemehla mehn Amalek koaros.
A nei sounpei kan me sohte kemehla sihpw oh kou keieu mwahu kan me re koledi; pwe re wahdo wasaht nan Kilkal, mehn wia meirong ong KAUN-O, omwi Koht.”
Samuel ahpw patohwan, “Mehnia tiahk me KAUN-O kin ketin kupwurperenki, rehn peik de kisakis oh meirong? Eri, peik me mwahusang mehlel meirongkihong sihpw me keieu kaselel kan.

Kahngohdiong ih, iei mehkot suwed, duwehte dipen wunani; oh aklapalap ong ih, duwehte dipen pwongih dikedik en eni. Eri, pwehki omwi soikalahr mahsen en KAUN-O, e pil ketin soingkomwilahr sang omwi nanmwarki.”
Sohl ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “I dipadahr, ni ei sohte kapwaiada mahsen en KAUN-O oh omwi kaweid kan. I masakada nei aramas akan oh mweidohng re en wia nsenarail.
Eri met, I patohwan peki mahkpen dipeiet; oh komwi en iangiehda kohla Kilkal, pwe I en kak iang komwi kaudokiong KAUN-O.”
Samuel ahpw sapeng, patohwan, “I sohte pahn iang komwi pwurala. Komw soikalahr mahsen en KAUN-O oh e ketin soingkomwilahr sang omwi nanmwarkien Israel.”
Samuel eri pirekekla pwe en kohkohla, a Sohl ahpw poaralahng eh likoun likio oh koledi, e ahpw tehrpeseng.
Samuel ahpw padahkihong Sohl, “KAUN-O ketin tehrasang komwi rahnwet wehin Israel oh ketikihong emen tohrohr me mwahusang komwi.
Koht lapalp en Israel sohte kin ketin likamw de wekidala kupwure. Kaidehk ih aramas me kin ketin wekidala kupwure.”

Sohl ahpw sapeng, mahsanih, “I dipadahr mehlel. A komw kihong wauwi mwohn mesen kaunen nei aramas akan oh pil mwohn mehn Israel koaros. Komw ketin iang ie pwurala pwe I en kak kaudokiong KAUN-O, omwi Koht.”
Samuel eri iang pwurala Kilkal, Sohl ahpw kaudokiong KAUN-O.
Samuel eri patohwan, “Kumwail kahrehdo mwohi Nanmwmarki Akak.” Akak eri pakahrla mwohn Samuel, wie rerrerki eh masepwehk oh mengimengloalki, “Ia uwen kansensuwed en ei pahn kamakamlaht!”

Samuel eri patohwanohng, “Nin duwen sapwellimomwi kedlahs eh kahrehiong lih neitik tohto eh sohla nair seri, ih duwen met omwi nohno solahr pahn nah seri.” Ih eri alehte Akak, pelepeseng mwohn pei sarawien Kilkal.
Samuel eri kohkohla Rama, oh Nanmwarki Sohl ahpw ketiketla Kipea.
Samuel eri sohla pwurehng kilang Sohl erein eh mour; e ahpw kin wie nsensuwedki. KAUN-O ahpw ketin kupwur toutoukihla eh ketin kasapwilada Sohl en wia nanmwarkien Israel.

footnotes.text: 15.15 KAMWOMWALA DOULUHL: Mahn pwukat kasarawihongehr KAUN-O, oh e pahn kamwomwmwomwla douluhl (tehk Lip 27.28).
